SUN_S1E01_P01.speaker: Kael
SUN_S1E01_P01.text: I'm sorry, sir. I think you've mistaken me for somebody.

SUN_S1E01_P01.speaker: Kael
SUN_S1E01_P01.text: Then I suppose he has my sympathy.

SUN_S1E01_P02.speaker: Eva
SUN_S1E01_P02.text: And then he threw a bottle at you.

SUN_S1E01_P02.speaker: Eva
SUN_S1E01_P02.text: You don't want to know why?

SUN_S1E01_P02.speaker: Eva
SUN_S1E01_P02.text: A stranger recognizes your face, calls you by another man's name, throws glass at your head, and you're not curious?

SUN_S1E01_P02.speaker: Kael
SUN_S1E01_P02.text: I've got enough problems I already understand. I don't much care about ones I don't.

SUN_S1E01_P02.speaker: Kael
SUN_S1E01_P02.text: Bah. Leave it alone. I didn't mean anything by that.

SUN_S1E01_P02.speaker: Eva
SUN_S1E01_P02.text: You absolutely meant something by that.

SUN_S1E01_P03.speaker: Jessa
SUN_S1E01_P03.text: It's too hot here for you. We're getting out.

SUN_S1E01_P03.speaker: Jessa
SUN_S1E01_P03.text: I'm not talking about the weather.

SUN_S1E01_P03.speaker: Jessa
SUN_S1E01_P03.text: Then get in the rig by yourself.

SUN_S1E01_P03.speaker: Jessa
SUN_S1E01_P03.text: Mine. That's why this is going so well for me.

SUN_S1E01_P03.speaker: Eva
SUN_S1E01_P03.text: Is there room for one more?

SUN_S1E01_P03.speaker: Jessa
SUN_S1E01_P03.text: There is. I haven't decided whether there should be.

SUN_S1E01_P04.speaker: Marcus
SUN_S1E01_P04.text: Varnok always did have to make himself noticed.

SUN_S1E01_P04.speaker: Kael
SUN_S1E01_P04.text: I don't know Varnok, and I don't know you. If you're going to stand there, hold his shoulders while I get the rope off.

SUN_S1E01_P05.speaker: Marcus
SUN_S1E01_P05.text: You burned my brother out of this place.

SUN_S1E01_P05.speaker: Marcus
SUN_S1E01_P05.text: You expect me to forget that face?

SUN_S1E01_P05.speaker: Kael
SUN_S1E01_P05.text: I don't expect anything from you. I need you to stop swinging that pipe near his head.

SUN_S1E01_P05.speaker: Kael
SUN_S1E01_P05.text: Thank you. Easy, sir. Small sips.

SUN_S1E01_P05.speaker: Marcus
SUN_S1E01_P05.text: Look at me when I'm talking to you.

SUN_S1E01_P05.speaker: Kael
SUN_S1E01_P05.text: I'm also trying to keep this man breathing. You can have the rest of my attention when he's done with it.

SUN_S1E01_P06.speaker: Kael
SUN_S1E01_P06.text: He can breathe. Give me a second.

SUN_S1E01_P06.speaker: Kael
SUN_S1E01_P06.text: That still doesn't make you invited.

SUN_S1E01_P06.speaker: Jessa
SUN_S1E01_P06.text: Both of you can settle this after we're moving.

SUN_S1E01_P07.speaker: Jessa
SUN_S1E01_P07.text: Dark coat, black hair. Half the road looks like that after sunset.

SUN_S1E01_P07.speaker: Kael
SUN_S1E01_P07.text: I care that somebody threw a bottle at me. I don't much care what story he told himself before he did it.

SUN_S1E01_P07.speaker: Eva
SUN_S1E01_P07.text: I was keeping my options open.

SUN_S1E01_P07.speaker: Eva
SUN_S1E01_P07.text: You had his bag before he agreed to leave.

SUN_S1E01_P07.speaker: Jessa
SUN_S1E01_P07.text: I trust what I've seen him do.

SUN_S1E01_P07.speaker: Jessa
SUN_S1E01_P07.text: I don't know him well enough for a careless one.

SUN_S1E01_P07.speaker: Kael
SUN_S1E01_P07.text: I can hear both of you.

SUN_S1E01_P07.speaker: Kael
SUN_S1E01_P07.text: Do either of you know where we're going?
